**Incident:** Synthetic pump fire · 2024-03-20

## Bottom line

- The spares record and the field accounts describe the seal work differently; the session asks the team how the job is really done. [FND-0003; EVD-0001; EVD-0003]
- Start with return to service: the team knows what the missing checklist meant on shift. [FND-0002] *(learning: LR-01)*

## Questions for the team

**Q: What made sense at the time about restarting the pump after the seal change?** [FND-0001]
- Why it matters: The export records the restart; the team knows what the shift needed then.

**Q: What made sense at the time about returning the pump to service with no checklist to hand?** [FND-0002]
- Why it matters: No return-to-service checklist existed; the team knows what took its place.

**Q: What made sense at the time about buying seals locally when the specified ones were not in stores?** [FND-0003; EVD-0003]
- Why it matters: The spares record shows local purchases; the team knows how the choice was made.

**Q: What made sense at the time about how the gas alarm was answered with no automatic shutdown?** [FND-0004]
- Why it matters: The alarm had no trip; the team knows the usual first response.

## Session plan

| Minutes | Activity | Purpose | Cites |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | Welcome, the ground rules and the banner read aloud | Set a learning frame: no blame, no judgement of people |  |
| 15 | Walk through the job as it is normally done | Hear work as done before comparing it with the procedure | FND-0001 |
| 30 | Work through the questions, one at a time | Collect the team's own answers | FND-0001; FND-0002; FND-0003; FND-0004 |
| 10 | Soak: a short break, then what surprised you | Let the first answers settle before fixes |  |
| 10 | What would make the job easier to do safely | Gather the team's ideas; no decisions on people | FND-0003 |

## Notes for the facilitator

- [ ] The workers are the experts on the work: ask, listen and write down their words, not your summary.
- [ ] Learn first and fix later: keep the first meeting for discovery and hold fixes for a second meeting after a soak.
- [ ] Ask how the work normally goes, not only about the day of the event.
- [ ] The team records its answers, in its own words, in learning-team-notes.csv; the facilitator never fills in the answer column for them.
